phases.name: Start of Round
phases.summary: In Rounds 2-5, discard the three leftmost face-up Main Orders, slide the remaining two left and refill the display to five; refill Tech displays and ready once-per-round abilities.

phases.name: Work Phase
phases.summary: Players alternate placing one worker and resolving that location until all have passed or placed all workers.

phases.name: Firing Phase
phases.summary: If either Shared or Imperial Kiln contains ceramics, resolve Test Pieces, secret Contributions (including secret Fuel Ledger commitments), Base Heat, Kiln Yard Shifu repositioning, Fire, Actual Heat, Kiln abilities, Quality, after-Quality Techs and Workshop Seconds.

phases.name: Order Phase
phases.summary: In reverse turn order, each opportunity completes at most one held or face-up Order or passes. Continue until a full circuit has no completion. Each Crown advances Imperial Recognition by one.

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.summary: Return workers, discard held Orders down to the limit of 3, pass First Player clockwise and advance the round.
